common.tagline: Snap a product photo. Get a store listing in English and Bangla.

demo.banner: You're in a demo shop. Products go to our test store.
demo.cta: Sign in to use your own store
demo.expired: This demo shop has ended after 24 hours. Start a new demo or sign in with Google.

signIn.title: Sign in to your shop
signIn.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. It works for 15 minutes.
signIn.terms: By continuing you agree to use ListSnap for products you're allowed to sell.
signIn.devMailNote: Development: the link is printed in the server console.
signIn.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
signIn.errorExpired: That link has expired. Send a new one.

landing.title: From one photo to a store-ready listing
landing.body: ListSnap finds the product in your photo, cuts it out, writes the listing in English and Bangla, makes studio photos and saves a draft to your WooCommerce store.
landing.steps: Photo → cutout → listing → studio photos → store draft

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.freeBody: 20 listings a day, 60 images. Nothing to pay during the beta.
pricing.proBody: Pay per listing, about the cost of a cup of tea. Coming later.

onboarding.title: Set up your shop
onboarding.body: Name your shop now. Connecting WooCommerce and Instagram comes next.
onboarding.errorName: Give your shop a name (2–80 characters).

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Snap a product to make your next listing.
dashboard.empty: No listings yet. Your first one takes about a minute.
dashboard.listingsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No listings} one {# listing} other {# listings}}

snap.title: New listing
snap.intro: Take or upload up to 5 photos of one product. A plain background and good light work best.
snap.drop: Drop photos here, or paste from the clipboard
snap.selected: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} ready
snap.tooMany: Up to 5 photos of one product.
snap.notPhoto: That file isn't a photo. Use JPG, PNG or HEIC.
snap.uploadFailed: The upload didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
snap.tips: Fill the frame with the product, avoid shadows, one product per photo.
snap.recentEmpty: Your listings will show up here.
snap.sampleFailed: The sample photo didn’t load. Try again.

job.title: Making your listing
job.failedHint: This step failed. Your other work is safe.
job.chooseBody: Pick the items to list and how to list them.
job.chooseConfirm: Continue with {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
job.doneTitle: {count, plural, one {Your listing is ready} other {Your # listings are ready}}
job.doneBody: Check the text, then save it to your store. Products are always saved as drafts.
job.notFound: This job isn't in your shop.
job.offline: You're offline. The steps continue when you're back.
job.saveFailed: Your store didn’t answer. Your listing is safe here. Try again.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Your work is saved. Try again, or go back to the dashboard.
errors.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist or isn't in your shop.

done.title: Saved to your store
done.heading: {count, plural, one {Draft saved} other {# drafts saved}}
done.body: “{title}” is in your store as a draft.
